issue_request: FHIR-44052 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I clarification request for R6. It reported that the maturity table label "Draft (0)" made the Draft standards status to FMM 0 relationship unclear, and its approved resolution was to change "Draft (0)" to "FMM 0" in the maturity table.
initial_application: The requested source change was already applied in source/versions.html. Git history shows an earlier FHIR-44052 commit on 2025-02-20 and the current-lineage commit 6d88889ec3eb977bf53d55346ddb9fa5267d61d9 on 2025-11-03 replacing "Draft (0)" with bold "FMM 0".
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2024-05-13 record FHIR-44052 as Persuasive with an Eric Haas/Corey Spears 11-0-0 vote, matching Jira. Additional Jira wording searches found only FHIR-44052, and a quoted Zulip key search found no discussion that changes the conclusion. The relevant source is source/versions.html, the top-level source page for versions.html#maturity.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/versions.html already labels the first maturity row "FMM 0" and explicitly states that artifacts at this level must have Draft standards status.
